title: chore: pause the pollinations.ai production deploy
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Pauses the automatic pollinations.ai deploy on pushes to `production`.
- Main now has the new Home and Apps next to the old Play and Community. The next promotion would ship that mix.
- Enter, gen and media keep deploying through `Deploy / Cloudflare production`.
- Manual deploy (`workflow_dispatch`) still works. To resume, uncomment the `push` trigger once all website v2 pages are on main (#14472).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: A pause for the website
gist.blurb: The website deploy gets a manual switch while its v2 pages catch up. Enter, gen, and media keep their usual route.
gist.summary: The pollinations.ai Cloudflare workflow drops its automatic deploy on pushes to production, retaining manual workflow_dispatch deploys while the remaining website v2 pages are completed; Enter, gen, and media deployments are unchanged.
gist.impact: Website promotions can wait until Home, Apps, Play, and Community are ready together, while manual website deploys and the other production deployments remain available.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed deployment desk represents the website workflow: Polli rests a paw on a paused automatic lever beside a clearly labeled manual switch. Four small page cards for Home, Apps, Play, and Community sit among growing code-plants; a separate terminal shows Enter, gen, and media continuing on their own path.
